[[Lady]] '''M'Arshngton''' was a [[Gender|female]] who,<ref name="Rebel Resolve" /> approximately four [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> was imprisoned along with many others by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rebel Resolve" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The name "[[Lady]] M'Arshngton" first appeared in "[[Rebel Resolve]]," the twelfth episode of [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|the first season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''; written in [[Aurebesh]] in a [[prisoner]] data file. The designation "TK-1138" next to her name<ref name="Rebel Resolve" /> brings to mind [[TK-421]], an [[Stormtrooper|Imperial stormtrooper]] from {{Film|IV}}.<ref name="Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[1138 (easter egg)|References to the number 1138]] are scattered throughout the ''Star Wars films''<ref name="SW">{{SW|url=news/beyond-a-cell-block-references-to-thx-1138-in-star-wars|text=Beyond a Cell Block: References to ''THX 1138'' in ''Star Wars''|nolive=1}} {{C|Note: The original article has been taken offline.}}</ref> (and other [[Lucasfilm]] productions),<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.buzzfeed.com/noradominick/star-wars-easter-eggs-details|text=23 Details From The "Star Wars" Movies That'll Make You Say, "How Did I Not Notice That?"|author=Nora Dominich|date=2022-03-30|quote=1138 appears and is mentioned a lot in the Star Wars movies, book, {{C|sic}} and other George Lucas films.|work=[[Wikipedia:BuzzFeed|Buzzfeed]]|archivedate=20221001133036}}</ref> and other ''Star Wars'' titles; honoring [[George Lucas]]' first feature film, ''[[Wikipedia:THX 1138|THX 1138]].<ref name="SW" />
